_comment: Carrier actually selected in each CJ product connection. This is what gets booked, so it is what pricing must be based on - costing against the cheapest available carrier understates freight whenever a faster one was deliberately chosen. Keep in step with the CJ connection table; config/carrier_audit.py reads this and reports drift.
_policy: Cheapest carrier delivering within 9 days. Fall back to the cheapest within 12 days when nothing faster exists, or when the fast option costs more than about $1.50 extra - four days of delivery speed is worth pennies on a 50%+ margin, but not dollars.
_source: Scraped from CJ's own Store Products -> Connected table on 2026-09-10, which is the booked carrier per connection. Previously hand-kept and covered only 19 of 48 live SPUs, so 30 products were priced against the cheapest carrier rather than the one actually booked. A carrier named here is still subject to freight_floor.credible_floor(): booking a carrier says WHICH carrier, not that its quoted price is real.
